_about: Rival scores on the local leaderboard, lowest first. Each is that bot's median run over 300 seeded games (docs/tuning-report.md), rounded to 10. script.kitty, mx_halcyon and NULL//SAINT were approved 2026-10-26 (NULL//SAINT recalibrated to 7,000 so the expert profile beats her in about 19% of runs); lil.byte, dex.hype, OXIDE and VESPER were added 2026-10-27 to spread the ladder from 850 to 7,000. Lines (SPEC.md, Rival flavor text): bio on the Rivals screen (NULL//SAINT's bio_after_beaten once she's beaten); on game over, the beaten line the first time a run beats a rival, else a close line within 10% of the next rival up, else one of their taunts, and above everyone one of NULL//SAINT's again lines.

rivals.name: lil.byte
rivals.label: tourist
rivals.bio: First night on the grid. Thinks the hex bytes are decorative. Having the best time.
taunts: lil.byte made it this far. You can too!
lil.byte left you a sticky note. It says "you got this :)"
lil.byte is still on their first run. It's going great.
Even lil.byte read the numbers on that one.
close: lil.byte is cheering for you. Loudly.
So close! lil.byte is holding the door open.
rivals.beaten: lil.byte is so proud of you. They're telling everyone.

rivals.name: script.kitty
rivals.label: rookie
rivals.bio: Learned to netrun last Tuesday. Guesses when she gets bored, which is often.
taunts: script.kitty is cackling. Somewhere, a tile she guessed on was safe.
script.kitty says it's not like she wanted you to lose or anything.
script.kitty guessed six times that run. Five worked. She will not be taking questions.
script.kitty: "nyaa~ skill issue." She scored 1,890.
close: script.kitty saw your score and pretended she didn't.
script.kitty is suddenly very interested in her own run.
rivals.beaten: script.kitty has left the chat. She'll be back. She always comes back.

rivals.name: dex.hype
rivals.label: streamer
rivals.bio: Streams every run to four loyal viewers. Narrates every click. Chords for the clip.
taunts: dex.hype is clipping your run for the fails compilation.
dex.hype told chat you'd choke. Chat agreed.
dex.hype: "Like and subscribe if you saw that mine coming."
dex.hype is reading your score out loud. Slowly.
close: dex.hype just said "wait, wait, WAIT" on stream.
Chat is spamming your name. dex.hype is sweating.
rivals.beaten: dex.hype ended the stream early. "Technical difficulties."

rivals.name: mx_halcyon
rivals.label: runner
rivals.bio: Fast hands, clean chords, zero patience for people who flag every single mine.
taunts: mx_halcyon didn't even look up.
mx_halcyon finished a whole run while you read this.
mx_halcyon has a note on you. It says "flags too much."
mx_halcyon would like the board back when you're done.
close: mx_halcyon is chording faster now. Unrelated, surely.
rivals.beaten: mx_halcyon nods once and logs off. From them, that's a standing ovation.

rivals.name: OXIDE
rivals.label: veteran
rivals.bio: Wrote half the lattice's ICE before Tetsukage let her go. Now she breaks it for fun, and slowly.
taunts: OXIDE built that mine. She remembers where it is.
OXIDE: "Back in my day the lattice had edges."
OXIDE doesn't flag. She just knows.
OXIDE has outlived three of your kind this week.
close: OXIDE is watching your run with professional interest.
rivals.beaten: OXIDE raises her mug to you, then goes back to bed.

rivals.name: VESPER
rivals.label: ace
rivals.bio: Ran with NULL//SAINT once. Has been second on every board since, and has opinions about it.
taunts: VESPER chorded that whole region while you were still hovering.
VESPER doesn't remember your name. She remembers your score.
VESPER: "Cute. Now do it with the signal low."
VESPER is busy chasing someone else. It isn't you.
close: VESPER glanced back. She never does that.
VESPER just sped up. Take it as a compliment.
rivals.beaten: VESPER says nothing and queues another run. Then another.

rivals.name: NULL//SAINT
rivals.label: netrunner
rivals.bio: Has never guessed. Has never hurried. Has never lost to you.
rivals.bio_after_beaten: Has never guessed. Has never hurried. Had never lost to you.
taunts: She saw that mine three moves before you did.
NULL//SAINT has not noticed you yet.
NULL//SAINT is still playing her run from last Tuesday.
Somewhere, NULL//SAINT decrypted another tile.
rivals.beaten: For the first time on record, NULL//SAINT has nothing to say.
again: NULL//SAINT moved her runs to a later hour.
NULL//SAINT said one word. Nobody heard it.
